A '''Squib spacer''' was present at a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] called [[The Maze]] at some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. When a would-be [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[operative]] bumped into the [[Squib/Legends|Squib]], [[Gender/Legends|she]] yammered angrily at the bumbler.
